title: Upcoming removal of AI Functions support on older runtimes
body: Starting in January 2027, [AI Functions](/aws/en/large-language-models/ai-functions) in SQL queries will no longer be supported on Databricks Runtime versions below 17.3 LTS. This change doesn't affect `ai_similarity` or the AI Functions REST API. To continue using AI Functions in SQL, use Databricks Runtime 17.3 LTS and above.
